visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands meticulously prepares a large head of green cabbage on a wooden cutting board in a brightly lit indoor kitchen. The person uses a sharp stainless steel knife to remove the core and then slices the leaves into fine, uniform shreds. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the fresh texture of the vegetable. (2) The shredded cabbage is transferred into a large metallic mixing bowl where white crystalline salt is sprinkled over it. The hands, wearing translucent plastic gloves, vigorously knead and toss the cabbage to draw out moisture. The background shows a clean kitchen counter with various cooking utensils and a light blue pot. (3) The scene shifts to green onions being sliced into small rounds. Following this, a block of pinkish ground meat is placed on a dark cutting board and chopped repeatedly with a knife to achieve a finer texture. The camera maintains a close-up perspective, focusing on the rhythmic physical movements of the hands. (4) In a pink ceramic bowl, the ground meat is mixed with clear liquid and dark brown sauces. The hands continuously stir the mixture until it becomes a sticky, integrated paste. Additional seasonings like pepper and sugar are visible as they are added from small spoons onto the meat surface. (5) The processed cabbage, meat, and green onions are combined in a large bowl and thoroughly mixed. Then, the process of wrapping dumplings begins. Individual circular dough skins are filled with a spoonful of the mixture, and the fingers expertly pleat the edges to seal them into a half-moon shape. (6) A batch of finished dumplings is placed in a flat-bottomed black frying pan with a drizzling of golden oil. After a brief period of frying, water is poured in, creating a cloud of white steam, and a glass lid is placed on top to allow the dumplings to steam-cook. (7) The lid is removed to reveal the golden-brown bottoms of the dumplings. The pan is then skillfully inverted onto a white ceramic plate. Finally, a woman with dark hair, wearing a white blouse and a pink apron, is seen at eye level, joyfully eating a dumpling and giving a thumbs-up.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 高麗菜清洗乾淨去掉梗. (2) [Subtitle]: 幾片葉子疊在一起先切細長條. (3) [Subtitle]: 轉個方向再切細. (4) [Subtitle]: 放到盆子裡. (5) [Subtitle]: 加入1%的鹽. (6) [Subtitle]: 甩一甩. (7) [Subtitle]: 用手搓揉一下加速出水. (8) [Subtitle]: 蔥白切開一刀讓蔥細一點. (9) [Subtitle]: 切成蔥花. (10) [Subtitle]: 準備250克的梅花肉或者胛心肉. (11) [Subtitle]: 用刀剁一剁大約3~5分鐘... (12) [Subtitle]: 一面剁好翻面再剁. (13) [Subtitle]: 可以兩手交替剁. (14) [Subtitle]: 直到肉表面產生毛邊黏黏的. (15) [Subtitle]: 像這樣.... (16) [Subtitle]: 絞肉放入盆子裡. (17) [Subtitle]: 先放一點水打水*(也可以準備蔥薑水). (18) [Subtitle]: 水分分次加慢慢吸收進去. (19) [Subtitle]: 最後會變軟軟白白的. (20) [Subtitle]: 加入調味料：糖 2克 胡椒 1克 清酒 15ml 醬油 5ml 蠔油 6ml. (21) [Subtitle]: 充分搓揉均勻. (22) [Subtitle]: 現在高麗菜已經出水了. (23) [Subtitle]: 用一個過濾網，用力的擠壓掉水分. (24) [Subtitle]: 到到盆子裡. (25) [Subtitle]: 絞肉放進來. (26) [Subtitle]: 充分的拌勻. (27) [Subtitle]: 青蔥放進來，拌勻. (28) [Subtitle]: 簡單的餡料就做好囉！. (29) [Subtitle]: 先放到冷凍一個小時會比較好包. (30) [Subtitle]: 取一張水餃皮放上約17克的餡料沾上半圈的水. (31) [Subtitle]: 中間先黏合，摺子往中間摺. (32) [Subtitle]: 另外一邊也摺兩個邊緣捏薄，捏緊. (33) [Subtitle]: 收口捏緊確認不會爆開個可愛的餃子就包好啦～ ❤️. (34) [Subtitle]: 喜歡這樣可愛的餃子 ❤️❤️. (35) [Subtitle]: 你可以放到冷凍保存想吃的時候隨時都有！ ❤️. (36) [Subtitle]: 熱鍋後，放入油. (37) [Subtitle]: 餃子底部抹上鍋裡的油，擺放一圈. (38) [Subtitle]: 大中火煎2分鐘左右直到底部有焦香為止. (39) [Subtitle]: 像這樣. (40) [Subtitle]: 加入大約70~80ml左右的熱水. (41) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋，中火煎3分鐘（冷凍餃子約4分鐘）. (42) [Subtitle]: 好囉，開蓋！. (43) [Subtitle]: 中火繼續煎到水分蒸發煎到底部脆殼 ✅. (44) [Subtitle]: 像這樣底部沒有水分. (45) [Subtitle]: 確認底部沒有沾黏. (46) [Subtitle]: 蓋上一個盤子. (47) [Subtitle]: 鍋子翻過來.... (48) [Variety]: 哇哇哇～～ ❤️❤️. [Slogan]: 超級好吃的高麗菜煎餃～❤️❤️. (49) [Slogan]: 超級好吃的『高麗菜煎餃』就完成啦～ ❤️❤️. (50) [Variety]: 底部非常脆！ ❤️ 內餡又多汁～. (51) [Variety]: 好囉～那我要開動囉！ ❤️❤️. (52) [Variety]: 嗯～太好吃了！好吃到停不下來 ❤️❤️❤️. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 Instagram: @RosalinaKitchen YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a series of sharp, rhythmic percussive strikes as a knife hits a wooden board, interspersed with the crisp, fibrous crunching of cabbage. An upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic BGM with guitar and piano textures establishes a cheerful mood. The background environmental noise is minimal, suggesting a studio setting. (2) A new phase starts with the wet, squelching sound of cabbage being kneaded by hand, creating a soft, friction-heavy texture. This is followed by a sudden increase in tempo of the knife strikes as they move to chopping meat, which has a duller, more thud-like acoustic signature compared to the vegetables. (3) The sound of liquid being poured into a bowl is heard, followed by a thick, viscous stirring sound as the meat paste is developed. The BGM remains constant, maintaining its major-key tonality and steady beat. Occasional metallic clinks of spoons hitting the bowl provide sharp, short-bandwidth transients. (4) A loud, high-frequency sizzling sound erupts as the dumplings hit the hot oil in the pan. This is interrupted by a distinct splash and a prolonged, broadband hiss of steam as water is added. The closing of the lid creates a muffled, low-frequency thud, followed by the sound of bubbling water. (5) The final phase is triggered by a loud scraping sound as a plate is placed against the pan. A female voice enters with high pitch and energetic prosody, expressing delight. Sounds of chewing and a satisfying 'mmm' are clearly audible, ending with a final cheerful phrase and the BGM fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an instructional cooking tutorial aimed at teaching viewers how to make cabbage pan-fried dumplings. It uses a fast-paced, high-information-density editing style to demonstrate the full process from raw ingredients to the finished dish, concluding with a positive tasting reaction to validate the recipe's success.
